With proper care, RFID cards typically last 2-3 years, significantly outlasting traditional magnetic stripe cards that need replacement every 6-12 months.

Technical Aspects

How do RFID hotel key cards work?

RFID cards use radio frequency identification technology to communicate with door locks:

  1. Card contains an embedded chip and antenna
  2. Reader emits a radio signal
  3. Chip responds with encrypted data
  4. System verifies credentials
  5. Door unlocks upon verification
